fcc_mba_webget.citation: FCC Measuring Broadband America, raw data release June 2016 (data-raw-2016-jun.tar.gz, raw unaudited). Series construction after H. Mao, R. Netravali, M. Alizadeh. Neural Adaptive Video Streaming with Pensieve. ACM SIGCOMM 2017 (github.com/hongzimao/pensieve traces/fcc/load_webget_data.py)
fcc_mba_webget.format: curr_webget CSV: unit_id, dtime, target, address, fetch_time, bytes_total, bytes_sec, ...: one row per web page fetch (about hourly per unit and target)

subset_rule.caveat: consecutive values are fetches about an hour apart, each held 5 s (Pensieve's construction): a composed series, not a measured per-second trace
subset_rule.draw: random.Random(seed).sample(sorted(keys with >= min_values), min(sample, n)), sorted
subset_rule.series: one per (unit_id, target), its rows sorted by dtime
subset_rule.value: bytes_sec (column 6); rows with no numeric bytes_sec dropped

hsdpa_3g_norway.citation: H. Riiser, P. Vigmostad, C. Griwodz, P. Halvorsen. Commute Path Bandwidth Traces from 3G Networks: Analysis and Applications. ACM MMSys 2013. doi:10.1145/2483977.2483991
hsdpa_3g_norway.format: whitespace: unix s, monotonic ms, lat, lon, bytes since the previous row, ms since the previous row (~1 s rows); per-second kbit/s by spreading each row's bytes over its interval

lte_4g_ghent.citation: J. van der Hooft, S. Petrangeli, T. Wauters, R. Huysegems, P. Rondao Alface, T. Bostoen, F. De Turck. HTTP/2-Based Adaptive Streaming of HEVC Video over 4G/LTE Networks. IEEE Communications Letters 20(11):2177-2180, 2016
lte_4g_ghent.format: whitespace: epoch ms, ms since start, lat, lon, bytes since the previous row, ms since the previous row (~1 s rows); per-second kbit/s as for hsdpa
